The '''Comet Broom Service''', also known as '''Comet Broom''', was a company that operated in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]] during the waning years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Description==
The Comet Broom Service was charged with making the space lanes through the [[Cularin comet cloud]] safe for shipping. It destroyed rogue [[Comet/Legends|comets]] that strayed into shipping paths and supplied astrometric data to [[Cularin SpaceNav]], showing safe courses through the cloud. They also occasionly used [[Detonite/Legends|detonite]] or [[Mine/Legends|mines]] to alter the courses of large comets.

The company employed about 40 permanent and 60 temorary members of staff and was based on [[Artom Station]]. It sometimes sub-contracted out jobs to the rival firm [[Comet Busters]].

==History==
The Comet Broom Service was ran by the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]] [[Mronk]] and [[Rroorgli]]. During the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Garth Ezzar]] disguised himself as [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Lanius Qel-Bertuk]] and met with the two Wookiees to hire the Service to initiate the [[Cometary Water Reclamation Project]]. The project was supposedly meant to launch a comet into the atmosphere of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Almas]], to add more [[Water/Legends|water]] to the atmosphere, although Ezzar had other plans for it.

Ezzar deliberately placed a mistake in the data supplied by the Service. This resulted in the [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] ''[[Fricasseed Nerf]]'' being damaged and the [[heroes of Cularin]] were hired to investigate. They traveled to Artom Station and met with Mronk and Rroorgli, who assured them that there had been no problems with the data.

A short time afterwards, Garth Ezzar murdered Mronk and Rroorgli. Their bodies were discovered by a Comet Broom security team, which then stopped any ships from landing on or taking off from the station until someone could be sent to investigate the deaths.
